description.text: The first set of the XY series and of the sixth generation, released on 5 February 2014 with 146 cards of Kalos Pokémon, mostly from Pokémon X. It brought in the Fairy type, from the games, and Mega Evolution: a Mega Evolution evolves from a Pokémon-EX and is stronger still, but evolving into it ends the player's turn. The first two, Mega Venusaur-EX and Mega Blastoise-EX, came with six new Pokémon-EX.

description.text: The 1st Place League Challenge copy of Pumpkaboo: a crosshatch holofoil print stamped with the Pokémon League logo and its placing, the prize for first place. League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division. The crosshatch pattern marks the early League Challenge promos, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015.
